rationale: MRVL is down ~9% from prior close and sitting at 4.3% of today's range near the session low, with price well below VWAP ($183.97) and the 9-EMA ($179.96), indicating sustained selling pressure. While a short near the low risks a mean-reversion bounce and a long risks continuation of the downtrend, the lack of stabilization structure and the proximity to the day's low without a clear base formation make the risk/reward unattractive in either direction at this moment.
